name: How can you match paint if you don’t have the original can or color name?

mainEntity.name: How can you match paint if you don’t have the original can or color name?

acceptedAnswer.text: Matching paint without an existing can requires obtaining a physical sample. Home improvement and paint stores use spectrophotometer color-matching technology, which requires a clean sample at least the size of a quarter. You can slice a shallow piece of drywall paper from behind a baseboard, light switch plate, or inside a closet. Keep in mind that sheen (flat, eggshell, satin) must also be matched accurately, as incorrect sheen will stand out under room lighting.
acceptedAnswer.description: Cut a quarter-sized drywall paper sample from an inconspicuous spot, such as behind an outlet cover, and take it to a paint supplier for digital color and sheen matching.
